# boxbox_machines (Data Source)

The caller's machines: a tenant's own pool, for the owner every tenant's (`GET machines`). Machines made by the owner's config are included.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `tenant` (String) Only this tenant's machines. A tenant can name only itself.

### Read-Only

- `machines` (Attributes List) The machines, ordered by tenant, then name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--machines))

<a id="nestedatt--machines"></a>
### Nested Schema for `machines`

Read-Only:

- `addresses` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--machines--addresses))
- `cpu` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--machines--cpu))
- `disk` (String) Disk.
- `ha` (Attributes) Replication and HA; null without replicas. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--machines--ha))
- `id` (String) `<tenant>/<name>`.
- `image` (String) Image the machine was created from; null when not known (`config` machine).
- `memory` (String) Memory as configured (see `pending`).
- `name` (String) Name of the machine.
- `node` (String) Node the machine is on now.
- `pending` (Attributes) What waits for the next stop and start from PVE; null when nothing waits. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--machines--pending))
- `phase` (String) `creating`, `ready`, `failed` or `destroying`.
- `reason` (String) Why the phase is `failed`; otherwise null.
- `source` (String) `api` (made through the API) or `config` (made by the owner's config; read-only here).
- `status` (String) `running` or `stopped`.
- `tenant` (String) Tenant that owns the machine.
- `user` (String) Login user; null for a `config` machine.
- `vmid` (Number) PVE's ID of the machine.

<a id="nestedatt--machines--addresses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `machines.addresses`

Read-Only:

- `internal` (String) IPv4 address in the tenant's internal network.
- `nat` (String) IPv4 address in the NAT network.


<a id="nestedatt--machines--cpu"></a>
### Nested Schema for `machines.cpu`

Read-Only:

- `max` (Number) Threads the machine sees (as configured; see `pending`).
- `min` (Number) Guaranteed threads.


<a id="nestedatt--machines--ha"></a>
### Nested Schema for `machines.ha`

Read-Only:

- `nodes` (List of String) Nodes PVE replicates to now.
- `protected` (Boolean) Every replica has a successful sync and the machine is an HA resource.
- `replicas` (Number) Replicas asked for.
- `restart` (Boolean) Whether the machine is an HA resource; null until the server reports it.


<a id="nestedatt--machines--pending"></a>
### Nested Schema for `machines.pending`

Read-Only:

- `cpu_max` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--machines--pending--cpu_max))
- `memory` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--machines--pending--memory))

<a id="nestedatt--machines--pending--cpu_max"></a>
### Nested Schema for `machines.pending.cpu_max`

Read-Only:

- `configured` (Number)
- `running` (Number)


<a id="nestedatt--machines--pending--memory"></a>
### Nested Schema for `machines.pending.memory`

Read-Only:

- `configured` (String)
- `running` (String)
